detector.description: Alerts when container restart count in the last 5m is > 0
detector.name: K8S Container Restart Count is > 0
detector.programText:
A = data('k8s.container.restarts').sum(by=['k8s.namespace.name', 'k8s.pod.name', 'k8s.container.name', 'k8s.cluster.name']).delta().sum(over='5m').above(0, inclusive=True, clamp=True).publish(label='A')
detect(when(A > threshold(0), lasting='5m'), auto_resolve_after='2d').publish('K8S Container Restart Count is > 0')

rules.description: The value of Container Restarts is above 0.
